Type: cabinet
Name: ROCKPOINT TV Stand, 42x16x23.6inch, Walnut Brown
Colors: Walnut Brown
Materials: wood
TV stand / media storage console in a traditional highboy style; ideal for a bedroom, living room, or game room Accommodates most flat-panel TVs up to 48 inches; supports up to 250 pounds Open storage space with adjustable-height shelf; bottom storage drawer; 2 side storage cabinets with swing-open doors High-grade MDF and durable laminate construction; rich, textured finish; ships ready to assemble (instructions included) Measures 16 by 42 by 32 inches (LxWxH); weighs 105 pounds
